limits: No browser components, DOM or CSS runtime
No physical background blur or spring animations
No screen-reader accessibility certification
Chinese text injection is not IME composition testing
No live simulateClick tests because of known GPUIX 0.7.0 native reentrancy
No package publication or system setting changes
No full Darwin or Untitled UI component parity; missing components documented in package README
Programmatic focus/blur events were absent in 0.7.0 TestRenderer; managed keyboard and pointer focus is used
Dialog and UIKit Popover now share a renderer-local managed overlay stack; native Select/Tooltip, raw anchored, OS windows and cross-window arbitration are outside its scope
ContextMenu anchors to its trigger region; submenus navigate within one popup
Command shortcut strings are display labels; no shortcut registration or conflict management
DateField is a calendar-date text field, not Calendar/DatePicker
Search lists mount at most 50 matches; caller owns remote paging
0.7.0 scroll-node bounds include self scroll offset; viewport assertions compensate
ListView/TreeView/DataGrid render caller-paged data; no collection virtualization or row drag/drop
DataGrid supports string cell edits, not a spreadsheet or async persistence layer
Document dirty-close confirmation belongs to the application
Form controller supports flat string fields and synchronous validation only
File controls emit application intents; no system picker, upload or drop handling
Charts use bounded categorical data (200 categories / 12 series, 50 pie slices), not continuous/time axes, zoom, export or virtualized rendering
Pie selection uses legend/keyboard; direct wedge hit testing is not implemented
Messages and activity render application-provided windows; no virtual history or prepend scroll anchoring
Composer emits snapshot/stop/attachment intents; no network, file access or persistence
Message followTail is application-controlled and not disabled automatically by wheel input
Dashboard/Conversation/Settings are layout foundations; Settings lacks a complete independent scenario test
Window size is native-tested; title/activation only have forwarding-rule tests, not real-window outcome verification
Platform false flags mean unmapped UIKit capabilities, not unsupported OS features
Internal component labels are partly English; no complete localization layer
Slider/RangeSlider support thumb dragging, keyboard, optional bounded track clicks and marks; no logarithmic scales or touch gestures
Calendar and date pickers use Gregorian dates; optional month/year navigation and separate dual-month/range preset controls exist, but no date-time/timezone or AX calendar semantics
Calendar values and visible month are separately controlled; keyboard browsing may enter unavailable dates but cannot select them
Date ranges check every included date and are bounded by maxRangeDays (default 366, maximum 3660)
Slider precision uses 14 significant digits; it is not an arbitrary-precision numeric system
CheckboxGroup toggles only current enabled options; no server-wide query selection or AX checkbox certification
Original TokenField retains bounded synchronous batch entry; v0.13 separate combinations add suggestions/rename/drafts; no drag/drop, range selection or virtualization
GPUIX editor consumes Backspace and left/right before JSX; TokenField uses Shift+Tab to enter tokens
TokenField suppresses native Tab insertion by rebuilding its inner editor, resetting native undo/caret history while preserving controlled draft and component focus order
Input/Textarea resetKey is explicit native editor recreation, not a general IME/undo compatibility guarantee
Time controls use same-day HH:mm with minute steps aligned from min; no seconds, AM/PM, overnight ranges, date-time combination, timezone/DST conversion or system time panel
TimeList stores at most 1440 pure options and mounts eight rows per page; unavailable times are omitted
TimeField keeps application-owned raw drafts and commits only valid Enter or changed steps; Tab editor recreation resets native undo/caret history
Time disabled predicates must be synchronous and pure; no async availability or persistence
Slider trackPress defaults false and supports at most 201 stops; finer steps require disabling trackPress, and subpixel stops may require keyboard selection
Slider marks support at most 51 finite unique values; labels are bounded/truncated or omitted when dense; no label Tooltip or AX semantics
Slider track clicks are discrete selection, not press-and-drag from the empty track; hit-region boundaries use native target resolution
Dual calendars render exactly two adjacent months; explicit horizontal/vertical layout, no automatic responsive breakpoint or arbitrary month count
Dual month 9999-12 display clamps to 9999-11/12 without a mount-time onMonthChange callback
Range presets are bounded to 24 and use an explicit reference date; no system clock, asynchronous availability, or implicit clipping of invalid ranges
DateRangePanel has local draft Apply/Cancel semantics, not async persistence; external date value changes replace the draft and Cancel does not roll back visible month
DateRangeDialog inherits the managed Dialog layer; it does not expose a separate global modal service
Actions use flat six-row paginated menus; Popover inherits managed layering, while keyboard shortcut arbitration remains absent
Action/workspace collections are bounded to 100, groups to 12 and paths to 64; no remote lookup or virtualization
Toolbar visibleCount and path segment widths are application-controlled; no automatic width measurement or history/router integration
run callbacks emit application intent; loading is controlled and UIKit does not await, persist or handle authentication/sign-out
Windows/Linux, full IME and AX remain unverified for the new action/navigation combinations
Colors use 8-bit sRGB hex/RGBA; no CSS named/rgb/hsl strings, system sampling, gradients, P3 or ICC conversion
ColorField/ColorPanel onValueChange may emit invalid text drafts; ColorPicker isolates drafts and commits only Apply or explicit Clear
Palette data is capped at 96 entries, with two rows per page and 2-8 explicit columns; no remote search, drag reorder or persistence
Transparency is precomposited over a fixed checkerboard for preview; no display color-management certification
ColorPanel uses zero-height clipping and disables hidden focus targets because display:none did not hide the tested native subtree
Slider capture now owns temporary keyboard focus during nested drag and restores thumb/scope focus on finish or cancel
ColorField native Tab recreation resets editor undo/caret history; Windows/Linux, full IME and AX remain unverified
Notification queues are application-local memory; one viewport per queue, capacity <=100 and visible <=5; no OS notifications or history persistence
Hook queue options are initialization-only; external queue owners dispose controllers and own background visibility suspension
Notification keyboard/error pauses require explicit Resume; no accessibility announcement or global modal integration
TaskList accepts <=200 unique tasks and mounts <=10 per page; application owns jobs, cancellation and state transitions; pending guards are view-local
ProgressRing unknown mode is a static arc; no spinner/progress animation
Token suggestions use at most 500 application-provided entries and mount at most 8 rows; remote request scheduling and stale result handling belong to the application
TokenCombobox/Picker callbacks are synchronous controlled updates, not asynchronous persistence; free creation treats the whole draft as one label
TokenEditor uses maxTokens <=100 and <=8 rows per page; changing page discards unsaved local rename drafts; clear covers the entire supplied collection while preserving disabled/nonremovable tokens
TokenPicker inherits managed Popover layering; compact two-row candidates keep ordinary Apply/Cancel visible, large selections require scrolling
New token inputs inherit Tab editor recreation and native undo/caret reset; no full IME or AX semantics
Modal focus restoration requires explicit refs and parent React context; independent siblings do not automatically choose a surviving sibling focus target
Sheet/Drawer are window-contained JSX surfaces, not AppKit NSWindow sheets or nonmodal inspectors
Confirm/Prompt async identity guards protect UI callbacks only; applications own operation cancellation and record revision
Prompt validation is synchronous, bounded to 10000 UTF-16 code units, and exact submitted-value acknowledgement is distinguished from external replacement
Prompt native Tab recreation resets editor undo/caret history; pending and generic labels are not fully localized
ProgressDialog emits task action intent only; unknown progress is a static arc and background execution belongs to the application
SourceListSidebar is flat grouped navigation capped at 20 groups/100 items, all mounted; no virtualization, nested outline, multi-selection or drag/drop
Source search and header/footer slots are application-owned; disabled/loading lock the source list, not arbitrary slot controls
Source collapse and collection changes do not silently rewrite application selection; onValueChange emits explicit navigation/activation only
SourceListRow action label is a short visible label; supplied icons are not bundled SF Symbols and the application owns icon color
NavigationSplitView requires explicit available width/height; temporary pane removal preserves preferences but unmounts content, so drafts and requests belong above the layout
Focus-region restoration uses UIKit recorded focus and an explicit fallback ref, not OS/AX queries; GPUIX internal editor pointer/End and unforwarded native focus changes remain unobservable
windowActive is an application-provided visual flag; no OS window activation, vibrancy, Liquid Glass or system accent service
Mail and Files gallery modes are in-memory navigation examples, not complete mail/file applications or connected services
CollectionView is a bounded 100-item page with fixed card rows, 1-6 columns and explicit available width; no virtualization, drag/drop or interactive children beneath the hit layer
LazyTreeView validates all loaded nodes including collapsed branches, up to 200 nodes and 9 levels; no automatic mount/externally expanded loading, branch pagination or scroll anchoring
Resource request locks isolate UI state by identity/revision/action token; actual cancellation, stale response validation and application data mutations remain caller-owned
AsyncListView unmounts the body for initial loading/error/empty; refreshing keeps items; native focus/scroll restoration across state replacement is not guaranteed
Collections examples use in-memory Promise failures/successes and do not access file or network services
Filter expressions support one all/any level, up to 24 fields/12 conditions; no nested groups, range/multiple-value relations or remote query execution
FilterBuilder mounts 1-3 condition rows per page and expects an adequately sized parent area (560 px recommended); no internal vertical scroll or universal narrow-container guarantee
FilterPanel owns a draft that resets with external expression/field/revision changes; Cancel emits an intent, while application owns closing or resetting the panel
SavedViewPicker supports up to 50 application-owned views and six-row menus; UI read-only/disabled guards are not server authorization
Saved-view operations share a snapshot lock and clone filter values; database writes, cancellation, stale responses and actual view collection updates remain caller-owned
Native focus order follows child-first registration; filters isolate ancestor keydown redispatch; general GPUIX editor Tab/IME/clipboard behavior is not replaced
